第30章 二等鬼差-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

吴姜愣在原地，眼睛瞪得溜圆，就那么直勾勾的盯着八仙桌旁的四位阴帅大人，直到马面一拍桌子，高声喊道：“自摸！胡了！赶紧给钱给钱！”

其他三位阴帅看到推牌的马面，骂骂咧咧的一人掏出一个手机，给马面转账。

吴姜更懵了，嘴巴微微张着，心里暗自嘀咕：好家伙，这地府都这么与时俱进了？居然连手机都普及了？

白无常心不甘情不愿地转完账，抬眼瞥见还傻站在门口的吴姜，语气带着几分不耐和随意：“那傻小子，愣在那儿干什么？赶紧过来！”

吴姜这才猛地回过神来，连忙收敛心神，快步走上前，对着八仙桌旁的四位阴帅恭恭敬敬地拱手行礼，语气恭敬却不卑不亢：“属下吴姜，见过四位阴帅大人！”

牛头放下手里的“手机”，抬眼上下打量了吴姜一番，瓮声瓮气地问道：“这小子就是吴姜？吴崇那老家伙的后人？”

黑无常点了点头，语气里带着几分赞许：“没错，就是他。刚到咱们勾魂司没多久，没想到已经有资格晋升二等鬼差了。”

吴姜听愣了，暗自咋舌不已，自家老祖宗原来不过是一个小小的县城隍，居然有这么有排面，牛头马面两位大神居然也认识他？

黑无常转头看向吴姜，开门见山：“把你的阴差令牌拿过来吧。”

吴姜不敢怠慢，连忙拿出自己的阴差令牌。

黑无常笑了笑，抬手轻轻一招，吴姜手中的令牌便自动飘到了他的掌心。

黑无常运起法力，指尖轻轻一点令牌，令牌瞬间发生了变化，原本通体黝黑的令牌，边缘还多了一圈细密的纹路，背面原本的“叁”变成“贰”。

“好了，可以了。”黑无常抬手一抛，令牌稳稳落回吴姜手中。

吴姜心中一喜，按朱宏介绍的，晋升二等阴差之后，可以接取的任务就更多了。另外，每个月还能多领一百贡献点的俸禄。

吴姜本来还想多留一会儿，好好拍一拍四位阴帅的马屁，搞好关系，可白无常却不耐烦地挥了挥手，摸出一瓶丹药，扔了过去：“行了行了，别杵在这儿碍事。这瓶聚魂丹赏你了，也算看在吴崇的面子上，给你的见面礼，滚吧！”

吴姜心里一喜，连忙接过。聚魂丹可是好东西，不光能提升修为，对以后突破境界也有好处。

恭敬的又行了一礼，这才轻手轻脚地退出了无常殿。

他没有选择直接返回阳间，而是去了任务交接处，一是和朱宏告别，二是顺便再问一下苏婉清的事情。

Wu Jiang froze on the spot, his eyes widened, staring straight at the four handsome men at the Eight Immortals table, until he slapped the table with his face and shouted loudly: "Touch yourself! What a fool! Give me money quickly!"

The other three Yin Shuais saw Ma Mian pushing the cards, and each of them cursed and took out a mobile phone to transfer money to Ma Mian.

Wu Jiang was even more confused, with his mouth slightly open, muttering to himself: Good guy, is this hell so advanced with the times?Even mobile phones are widely available?

Bai Wuchang reluctantly finished the transfer and looked up to see Wu Jiang, who was still standing stupidly at the door. His tone was a bit impatient and casual: "What are you doing there, silly boy? Come here quickly!"

Wu Jiang suddenly came back to his senses, quickly gathered his thoughts, walked forward quickly, and bowed his hands respectfully to the four Yin handsome men at the Eight Immortals table. His tone was respectful but neither humble nor overbearing: "My subordinate Wu Jiang, I have met four Yin handsome men!"

Niutou put down the "mobile phone" in his hand, raised his eyes and looked Wu Jiang up and down, and asked angrily: "Is this kid Wu Jiang? Is he a descendant of that old guy Wu Chong?"

Hei Wuchang nodded, with a hint of approval in his tone: "Yes, that's him. Not long after he arrived at our Seduction Department, I didn't expect that he was already qualified to be promoted to the second-class ghost officer."

Wu Jiang was stunned when he heard this, and was secretly stunned. His ancestor was just a small county town god, but he was so famous. The two great gods with an ox-headed horse face actually knew him?

Hei Wuchang turned to look at Wu Jiang and said straight to the point: "Bring over your Yinsha Token."

Wu Jiang did not dare to neglect and quickly took out his Yin Cha Token.

Hei Wuchang smiled, raised his hand and waved lightly, and the token in Wu Jiang's hand automatically floated into his palm.

Hei Wuchang mobilized his magic power and tapped the token with his fingertips. The token changed instantly. The originally dark token had a circle of fine lines around the edge, and the original "three" on the back became "two".

"Okay, that's it." Hei Wuchang raised his hand and threw it, and the token fell steadily back into Wu Jiang's hand.

Wu Jiang was overjoyed. According to Zhu Hong's introduction, after being promoted to the second-class Yinqian, he could take on more tasks.In addition, you can receive an extra 100 contribution points in salary every month.

Wu Jiang originally wanted to stay a little longer to flatter the four handsome men and build a good relationship with them, but Bai Wuchang waved his hand impatiently, took out a bottle of elixir, and threw it over: "Okay, okay, don't stand in the way. This bottle of soul-gathering elixir is a reward for you. It's also a meeting gift given to you for Wu Chong's sake, get out!"

Wu Jiang felt happy and quickly took it.The soul-gathering pill is a good thing. Not only can it improve your cultivation, it is also good for breaking through the realm in the future.

After bowing respectfully, he quietly exited the Hall of Impermanence.

He did not choose to return directly to the earthly world, but went to the mission handover office. First, he said goodbye to Zhu Hong, and second, he asked about Su Wanqing's affairs.
